privacy.screenDesc: Protect your locked notes with biometrics or a custom password, and guard against screenshots and app-switcher previews.
privacy.noteLockDesc: Lock individual notes from the note menu. Unlocks with {{method}}.
privacy.noteLockPasswordDesc: Locked notes unlock with your custom password on all synced devices.
privacy.noteLockUnavailableDesc: Device lock isn't set up on this device. Change the lock method from another synced device.

privacy.unlockMethodDesc: Choose how locked notes are unlocked.

reset.confirmMessage: This will permanently delete all your notes, media, and files on this device. This action cannot be undone and your data cannot be recovered if you haven't backed it up or synced with another device.

mediaSync.title: Media sync
mediaSync.pauseMediaDesc: Hold photos, video, and file transfers. Notes, folders, and settings keep syncing.
mediaSync.heldNotice: Media transfers are held. Queued items resume automatically once media is allowed again.
mediaSync.holdOnCellularDesc: Automatically hold photos, video, and files while on a mobile connection.

descriptions.general: Customize your personal workspace experience, from aesthetics to native language supports.
descriptions.sync: Manage your secure peer-to-peer network and linked devices with end-to-end encryption.
descriptions.backup: Create encrypted backups of your notes and media, or restore from a previous backup file.
descriptions.storage: Monitor your notes data size, on-disk footprint, and reclaim storage by clearing unreachable media.
descriptions.activity: See what each linked device has created, changed and removed.
descriptions.onDeviceAi: AI features that run on this computer. Your notes are never sent anywhere. Each feature downloads its model once, then works offline.

verdict.noDevices: Link a device to start syncing. Background and media settings apply once a device is linked.
verdict.neverSynced: Waiting for {{device}}. Both devices need to be online and on a network at the same time.
verdict.waiting: Waiting for {{device}} to come online. Notes will sync as soon as both devices are reachable.
verdict.canSleep: Running in the background. This computer can still sleep, which pauses syncing — disable sleep in your power settings to keep other devices up to date.

verdict.supported: On-device AI is ready to use on this computer.
verdict.limited: This computer has less memory, so the Best quality models may be slow. Lite and Standard work normally.

unsupportedReason.simulator: On-device AI only runs on a physical device. Everything else in Pear Notes works as usual.

unsupportedReason.gpu: On-device AI needs a supported graphics driver. Everything else in Pear Notes works as usual.
unsupportedReason.store-build: On-device AI isn't available in this build. Everything else in Pear Notes works as usual.

turnOn.messageWaiting: This downloads {{size}}. You're on a metered connection, so the download starts when you're on an unmetered one.

turnOff.title: Turn off {{feature}}?
turnOff.message: Keep the model to turn this back on without downloading again, or delete it to free {{size}}.

notEnoughSpace.title: Not enough space
notEnoughSpace.message: {{feature}} needs {{size}}. Pear Notes keeps some space free so your notes can always save. Free up {{short}} and try again.
notEnoughSpace.messageGeneric: A model download stopped because this computer is almost full. Free up some space and try again.

onDeviceAi.footer: Models are downloaded from the QVAC model library and checked before use. These settings apply to this computer only.
onDeviceAi.modelsEmpty: No models yet. Turn on a feature to download its model.
onDeviceAi.tierSwitchNote: Switching downloads the new model. The current one stays on this computer until you delete it.
onDeviceAi.deleteAllModelsDesc: Frees the space AI models use and turns off every AI feature on this computer. Your notes aren't affected.
onDeviceAi.sharedModel: Also used by {{features}}. Turn that off first to delete it.

deleteModelConfirm.title: Delete {{model}}?
deleteModelConfirm.message: This frees {{size}}. Your notes aren't affected.
deleteModelConfirm.messageUsers: This frees {{size}} and turns off {{features}}. Your notes aren't affected.

deleteAllConfirm.title: Delete all AI models?
deleteAllConfirm.message: This frees {{size}} and turns off every AI feature on this computer. Your notes aren't affected.

sync.title: Link devices

hero.title: Link your devices
hero.description: Create a secure, end-to-end encrypted connection to sync your notes across devices instantly.

invite.qrDescription: Open the link screen on your other device and scan this QR code to paste the invite instantly.
invite.warning: For security, don't share this code in public channels as it grants full access to your notes.
invite.expiredDesc: For security, invites are valid for {{minutes}} minutes. Generate a new one to link a device.

paste.hintInvalid: That isn't a complete invite code yet.

sync.footer: Your data moves directly between devices using encrypted Hypercore logs. No central server involved.

devices.indexerExplain: One device keeps the shared history in order, and sync stays fast while a single device does it — so devices you link join as followers. The sync leader cannot be removed until you make another device the leader.
devices.makeIndexerBody: {{name}} takes over keeping the history in order and this device stops. Both devices must stay online until the change finishes.
devices.errorLastIndexer: Every vault needs one sync leader. Make another device the leader first.
devices.errorDeviceOffline: That device must be online before it can become the sync leader.
devices.errorLeaderOffline: The current sync leader must be online to hand the role to another device.
devices.indexerOfflineNotice: {{name}} is the sync leader and is offline. Bring it back online to make another device the sync leader.
devices.errorGeneric: Could not change the sync leader. Please try again.
devices.makeIndexerTitleLocal: Make this device the sync leader?
devices.makeIndexerBodyLocal: This device takes over keeping the history in order. {{name}} must stay online until the change finishes.
devices.transferConfirming: Waiting for both devices to agree…
devices.errorTransferTimeout: The transfer has not completed yet. Keep both devices online and open — it will finish on its own.

permissions.cameraDescription: Allow camera access to scan an invite QR code and fill the pairing code automatically.

scanner.title: Scan invite QR code
scanner.description: Point your camera at the QR code shown on your other device to fill the invite automatically.

delete.title: Remove device?
delete.description: The device will lose the data sync and all data will be removed from that device.

backgroundSync.offDesc: Sync only while the app is open.

backgroundSync.alwaysOnDesc: Keep syncing continuously in the background with a persistent notification.
backgroundSync.permissionDescription: Allow notifications so Pear Notes can show a persistent sync status while running in the background.

hero.title: Secure your vault
hero.description: Backing up your data ensures you never lose your notes and files. All backups are encrypted with a password you choose and can be safely restored to any of your devices.

backup.lockedAuthReason: Authenticate to back up your locked notes

errors.incorrectRecoveryKey: Incorrect recovery key. Please check the key and try again.

password.createDesc: This password encrypts your backup. You'll need it to restore — it can't be recovered if lost.
password.enterDesc: Enter the password used to create this backup to decrypt your data.
